_about: Story line gates for the screen probe (story levels 1-5). A gate says what the player must not have seen yet (unseen) or must be able to see (seen) when a caption whose text contains `line` (case-insensitive) is up, and which earlier lines must already have played (after: substrings of their text). Ids must match things[].id from window.R.snap(). beforeGoal / afterGoal (objective ids) require a line while a goal is not yet done, or only once it is done. Add a gate whenever a script line asks about or points at something, or answers an earlier line.

story-L001.why: The commander asks what the light is before the reactor can be seen.
The commander finds the reactor only after asking what the light is.

story-L002.why: KILN names the lander's escape pod only once it has lit and the camera has shown it; until the pair is home it lies dark and unmarked.

story-L002.line: Two pods came down close together
story-L002.why: The two-pod line must come while the tow-two goal is still open.

story-L002.line: Then I'll bring in all five
story-L002.why: The commander agrees to all five only once the pair is home.

story-L002.line: Power's up. I can open bays
story-L002.why: KILN opens the bays only once all five pods are home.

story-L003.why: The commander sees only lights far to the south; the old kiosk is not yet in view (a glow on the screen edge points the way).
The commander finds the road and the shut-up kiosk only after walking to it, and only after the lights line.
Tam speaks after the grow dome is unlocked.
KILN explains credits after the first sale.

story-L004.why: KILN asks for the recorder by pointing at it, so the steel crate must be on screen when the line plays.

story-L004.line: A galley cooks greens into meals
story-L004.why: The galley is explained after the arrivals come through the gate.

story-L005.why: KILN points at the helmet the raider dropped, so it must be on screen when the line plays; the player then walks up and picks it up by hand.
